# graph_headroom — evolution seed for the dev-continuum-* family.  Identity stays
# outside EVOLVE-BLOCKs; Shinka operators may change only the implementation below.
#
# Why this seed and not `least_allocated` (the dev-medium-hot seed): on this family the
# dependency-blind policies are *infeasible* (worst SLO 0.88 against a 0.90 target), so
# seeding from one would start every arm outside the feasible region and turn the first
# half of every campaign into a feasibility hunt rather than a search.  This seed is the
# most SLO-margined feasible hand-written policy (0.95); it is also the *expensive* one
# (1.27 normalized energy against `latency_greedy`'s 0.83), which is deliberate — the
# search starts feasible and has an explicit, large energy gap to close rather than
# starting at the best baseline with nowhere to go.
POLICY_NAME: str = "graph_headroom"
POLICY_VERSION: str = "1.0.0"

# EVOLVE-BLOCK-START
def pressure(node: NodeState, cpu: int, mem: int) -> float:
    cpu_use = float(cpu) / float(max(node.cpu_capacity, 1))
    mem_use = float(mem) / float(max(node.mem_capacity, 1))
    peak = max(cpu_use, mem_use)
    return 18.0 * peak * peak / max(1.0 - peak, 0.02)

def link_cost(pod: Pod, node: NodeState, pods: list[Pod], graph: CallGraphCtx) -> float:
    weighted = 0.0
    weight = 0.0
    worst = 0.0
    for e in range(len(graph.src)):
        other = -1
        if graph.src[e] == pod.id:
            other = graph.dst[e]
        elif graph.dst[e] == pod.id:
            other = graph.src[e]
        if other >= 0 and other != pod.id and graph.rate[e] > 0.0:
            neighbor = pods[other]
            if neighbor.current_node >= 0:
                latency = node.latency_to_ms[neighbor.current_node]
                weighted += graph.rate[e] * latency
                weight += graph.rate[e]
                worst = max(worst, latency)
    if weight <= 0.0:
        return 0.0
    return weighted / weight + 0.40 * worst

def incremental_power(pod: Pod, node: NodeState) -> float:
    share = float(pod.cpu_request) / float(max(node.cpu_capacity, 1))
    power = max(node.power_max_w - node.power_idle_w, 0.0) * share
    if node.cpu_allocated == 0 and node.mem_allocated == 0 and node.suspendable:
        power += node.power_idle_w
    return power

def links_preserved(pod: Pod, source: NodeState, target: NodeState, pods: list[Pod], graph: CallGraphCtx) -> bool:
    for e in range(len(graph.src)):
        other = -1
        if graph.src[e] == pod.id:
            other = graph.dst[e]
        elif graph.dst[e] == pod.id:
            other = graph.src[e]
        if other >= 0 and other != pod.id and graph.rate[e] > 0.0:
            neighbor = pods[other]
            if neighbor.current_node >= 0:
                location = neighbor.current_node
                if target.latency_to_ms[location] > source.latency_to_ms[location]:
                    return False
    return True

def score(pod: Pod, node: NodeState, ctx: ClusterCtx) -> float:
    if node.suspended:
        return -1000000000.0
    cpu_after = node.cpu_allocated + pod.cpu_request
    mem_after = node.mem_allocated + pod.mem_request
    if cpu_after > node.cpu_capacity or mem_after > node.mem_capacity:
        return -1000000000.0

    # Keep latency uncapped and make contention expensive near saturation.
    network = link_cost(pod, node, ctx.pods, ctx.graph)
    queue = pressure(node, cpu_after, mem_after)
    energy = incremental_power(pod, node)
    return -(network + queue + 0.04 * energy)

def propose_moves(state: ClusterState, graph: CallGraphCtx, budget: int) -> list[Move]:
    out: list[Move] = []
    if budget <= 0:
        return out

    # Select one complete, resource-checked move per window. This avoids stale
    # capacity checks, duplicate moves and interacting migrations within a batch.
    best_gain = 0.0
    best_pod = -1
    best_target = -1
    for p in range(len(state.pods)):
        pod = state.pods[p]
        eligible = pod.current_node >= 0 and not pod.stateful and not pod.has_pdb
        if eligible:
            source = state.nodes[pod.current_node]
            source_cpu = source.cpu_allocated - pod.cpu_request
            source_mem = source.mem_allocated - pod.mem_request
            valid_source = not source.suspended and source_cpu >= 0 and source_mem >= 0
            if valid_source:
                old_links = link_cost(pod, source, state.pods, graph)
                old_pressure = pressure(source, source.cpu_allocated, source.mem_allocated)
                freed_pressure = old_pressure - pressure(source, source_cpu, source_mem)
                source_share = float(pod.cpu_request) / float(max(source.cpu_capacity, 1))
                saved_power = max(source.power_max_w - source.power_idle_w, 0.0) * source_share
                if source_cpu == 0 and source_mem == 0 and source.suspendable:
                    saved_power += source.power_idle_w
                for n in range(len(state.nodes)):
                    target = state.nodes[n]
                    cpu_after = target.cpu_allocated + pod.cpu_request
                    mem_after = target.mem_allocated + pod.mem_request
                    cpu_use = float(cpu_after) / float(max(target.cpu_capacity, 1))
                    mem_use = float(mem_after) / float(max(target.mem_capacity, 1))
                    fits = n != pod.current_node and not target.suspended
                    fits = fits and max(cpu_use, mem_use) <= 0.65
                    fits = fits and cpu_after <= target.cpu_capacity and mem_after <= target.mem_capacity
                    if fits:
                        new_links = link_cost(pod, target, state.pods, graph)
                        added_pressure = pressure(target, cpu_after, mem_after)
                        added_pressure -= pressure(target, target.cpu_allocated, target.mem_allocated)
                        latency_gain = old_links - new_links
                        queue_gain = freed_pressure - added_pressure
                        energy_gain = saved_power - incremental_power(pod, target)
                        useful = latency_gain >= 0.0 and queue_gain >= 0.0
                        useful = useful and energy_gain > 1.0
                        useful = useful and latency_gain + queue_gain > 3.0
                        if useful:
                            preserved = links_preserved(pod, source, target, state.pods, graph)
                            gain = latency_gain + queue_gain + 0.04 * energy_gain
                            if preserved and gain > best_gain:
                                best_gain = gain
                                best_pod = pod.id
                                best_target = n
    if best_pod >= 0:
        out.append(move_pod(best_pod, best_target))
    return out
# EVOLVE-BLOCK-END

        if graph.src[e] == pod.id:
            other = graph.dst[e]
        elif graph.dst[e] == pod.id:
            other = graph.src[e]
        if other >= 0 and other != pod.id and graph.rate[e] > 0.0:
            neighbor = pods[other]
            if neighbor.current_node >= 0:
                latency = node.latency_to_ms[neighbor.current_node]
                weighted += graph.rate[e] * latency
                weight += graph.rate[e]
                worst = max(worst, latency)
    if weight <= 0.0:
        return 0.0
    return weighted / weight + 0.40 * worst

def incremental_power(pod: Pod, node: NodeState) -> float:
    share = float(pod.cpu_request) / float(max(node.cpu_capacity, 1))
    power = max(node.power_max_w - node.power_idle_w, 0.0) * share
    if node.cpu_allocated == 0 and node.mem_allocated == 0 and node.suspendable:
        power += node.power_idle_w
    return power

def links_preserved(pod: Pod, source: NodeState, target: NodeState, pods: list[Pod], graph: CallGraphCtx) -> bool:
    for e in range(len(graph.src)):
        other = -1
        if graph.src[e] == pod.id:
            other = graph.dst[e]
        elif graph.dst[e] == pod.id:
            other = graph.src[e]
        if other >= 0 and other != pod.id and graph.rate[e] > 0.0:
            neighbor = pods[other]
            if neighbor.current_node >= 0:
                location = neighbor.current_node
                if target.latency_to_ms[location] > source.latency_to_ms[location]:
                    return False
    return True

def score(pod: Pod, node: NodeState, ctx: ClusterCtx) -> float:
    if node.suspended:
        return -1000000000.0
    cpu_after = node.cpu_allocated + pod.cpu_request
    mem_after = node.mem_allocated + pod.mem_request
    if cpu_after > node.cpu_capacity or mem_after > node.mem_capacity:
        return -1000000000.0

    # Keep latency uncapped and make contention expensive near saturation.
    network = link_cost(pod, node, ctx.pods, ctx.graph)
    queue = pressure(node, cpu_after, mem_after)
    energy = incremental_power(pod, node)
    return -(network + queue + 0.04 * energy)

def propose_moves(state: ClusterState, graph: CallGraphCtx, budget: int) -> list[Move]:
    out: list[Move] = []
    if budget <= 0:
        return out

    # Select one complete, resource-checked move per window. This avoids stale
    # capacity checks, duplicate moves and interacting migrations within a batch.
    best_gain = 0.0
    best_pod = -1
    best_target = -1
    for p in range(len(state.pods)):
        pod = state.pods[p]
        eligible = pod.current_node >= 0 and not pod.stateful and not pod.has_pdb
        if eligible:
            source = state.nodes[pod.current_node]
            source_cpu = source.cpu_allocated - pod.cpu_request
            source_mem = source.mem_allocated - pod.mem_request
            valid_source = not source.suspended and source_cpu >= 0 and source_mem >= 0
            if valid_source:
                old_links = link_cost(pod, source, state.pods, graph)
                old_pressure = pressure(source, source.cpu_allocated, source.mem_allocated)
                freed_pressure = old_pressure - pressure(source, source_cpu, source_mem)
                source_share = float(pod.cpu_request) / float(max(source.cpu_capacity, 1))
                saved_power = max(source.power_max_w - source.power_idle_w, 0.0) * source_share
                if source_cpu == 0 and source_mem == 0 and source.suspendable:
                    saved_power += source.power_idle_w
                for n in range(len(state.nodes)):
                    target = state.nodes[n]
                    cpu_after = target.cpu_allocated + pod.cpu_request
                    mem_after = target.mem_allocated + pod.mem_request
                    cpu_use = float(cpu_after) / float(max(target.cpu_capacity, 1))
                    mem_use = float(mem_after) / float(max(target.mem_capacity, 1))
                    fits = n != pod.current_node and not target.suspended
                    fits = fits and max(cpu_use, mem_use) <= 0.65
                    fits = fits and cpu_after <= target.cpu_capacity and mem_after <= target.mem_capacity
                    if fits:
                        new_links = link_cost(pod, target, state.pods, graph)
                        added_pressure = pressure(target, cpu_after, mem_after)
                        added_pressure -= pressure(target, target.cpu_allocated, target.mem_allocated)
                        latency_gain = old_links - new_links
                        queue_gain = freed_pressure - added_pressure
                        energy_gain = saved_power - incremental_power(pod, target)
                        useful = latency_gain >= 0.0 and queue_gain >= 0.0
                        useful = useful and energy_gain > 1.0
                        useful = useful and latency_gain + queue_gain > 3.0
                        if useful:
                            preserved = links_preserved(pod, source, target, state.pods, graph)
                            gain = latency_gain + queue_gain + 0.04 * energy_gain
                            if preserved and gain > best_gain:
                                best_gain = gain
                                best_pod = pod.id
                                best_target = n
    if best_pod >= 0:
        out.append(move_pod(best_pod, best_target))
    return out
